conclusion: Bounded declaration-token expansion is implemented and passes the selected semantic, streaming, allocation-failure and lint checks. Exact malformed diagnostics and handler-dependent Default fallback remain incomplete.
implementation: Iterative borrowed lexical frames expand internal PEs only in legal external/parameter declaration contexts; complete names and literals cannot splice across entity boundaries.
Grammar-only boundary whitespace remains separate from Default bytes; content-model groups can continue across frames.
Quoted tokens retain their physical/replacement origin and active parameter-name chain through value interpretation, preserving CR/LF semantics, recursion precedence and combined nesting limits.
Missing/disabled grammar references suppress declarations from their cursor position when not standalone, retain earlier attribute callbacks and emit skipped raw fragments.
Replacement bytes, empty-reference work, active-name copies, literal metadata, and pending callback structures are charged before allocation; output and depth have explicit limits.

validation.allocation_failures: Every allocation in the expanded core workload was faulted; zero global allocator use and no leaked blocks. FFI allocation/reentry suite also passed.
validation.clippy: cargo +ohm clippy -p oriole -p oriole_expat --all-targets -- -D warnings passed

scope: Matrices compare parent/child acceptance, child error codes, EntityDecl and Attlist payloads and concatenated Default bytes with declaration handlers registered. Root NotStandalone ordering is excluded as a pre-existing difference.
No claims of universal malformed callback/error-location parity are made.
remaining_limits: Malformed standalone repetition markers and general references in declaration grammar can report Syntax2 instead of InvalidToken4. An incomplete percent token in a replacement reports4 instead of5.

The focused matrix retains UnclosedToken5 vs expected IncompleteParameterEntity29 for whole declaration start/end fragments, and5 vs4 for an already incomplete physical quoted declaration when PE parsing is disabled. All reject.

Default-only consumers without EntityDecl/Attlist handlers retain incomplete whole-declaration fallback: skipped inline references may omit prefixes or duplicate raw references/suffixes. Six reproductions are preserved separately.
External PEs inside declaration grammar remain unsupported. External-value continuations are outside this layer.
A whole physical declaration is tokenized before semantic callback dispatch; handler changes and malformed-prefix callback timing are not fully Expat-equivalent.
integration_notes: Apply this layer after the external-header layer with a reviewed merge. Preserve the header layer entity_chain percent-name recursion checks and inherited_parameter_depth terms in entity_value.
Also add inherited_parameter_depth to declaration_tokens depth accounting and check inherited percent-prefixed entity_chain there; that field is absent from this layer base snapshot.
Merge the README paragraph with the external-header support description. No storage, header-continuation, FFI ABI or external-child runtime files were edited by this layer.
